/narrative.1: The overall objective of AgriFaRM-2 is to contribute to food and nutrition security and poverty reduction in Guinea. Its development objective is to sustainably increase the incomes of 70,000 family farms, their resilience to climate change as well as their sustainable access to local, urban and regional markets. The programming of AgriFaRM-2 interventions will be based on a territorial approach while prioritizing the rice and vegetable value chains. The targeting strategy will highly rely on the FOs structuring in the territories and will in priority find its entry point within existing cooperatives / regional unions and federationsThe overall objective of AgriFaRM-2 is to contribute to food and nutrition security and poverty reduction in Guinea.
